messages:
marcos: heads-up on PO RWI-4999 10-unit H200 order. Carrier flagged customs valuation mismatch, ETA moved to 2025-06-02. Vendor proposes 2 paths: EU replacement pool (faster, unit uplift) or depot repair in DE (slower, lower duties). Need a decision by EOD so infra can reserve Dedicated windows. AWB + CI required.

kelsey (NexaSupply): hi all :wave: quick summary from our ops team: replacement from our NL pool -> depart 2025-06-02 AMS, 48h clearance, estimated delivery 2025-06-04. Depot repair -> pickup 06-01, bench repair 6 biz days, ship back earliest 06-09, delivery ~06-12. Replacement uplift = $310/unit (base $7,000).

taylor-infra: timeline matters. Our Dedicated pool has two maintenance windows 06-04 and 06-05; we can ingest up to 6 units on 06-04 and remaining 4 on 06-05 if serials shipped with AWB. Can we get serial manifest ahead?

kelsey (NexaSupply): yes, we can split AWB 6 + 4 and attach serial manifest per AWB. Splitting increases handling fees slightly.

dave-procure: what's total uplift and payment terms? Any ability to net invoice on amendment?

kelsey (NexaSupply): uplift total = $310 * 10 = $3,100. We can amend PO RWI-4999 and extend 30d net on approved accounts. Immediate dispatch requires an uplift confirmation email.

sophie-ops: also ask about loaner coverage. If replacements delayed, can vendor provide loaners to avoid Dedicated capacity shortfall? We can't risk rolling back customer traffic.

kelsey (NexaSupply): short-term loaners: we have 4 H200 loaners in FRA depot, overnight dispatch for $140/unit/day. For 10-day loaner hold that'd be heavy. Recommend replacement path.

marcos: legal/finance note: we will not under-declare CI. Iris-legal already signalled no misdeclaration. Kelsey, confirm insurance payout basis.

kelsey (NexaSupply): insurance payout capped at declared CI value. If you choose repair route and use temporary import, insurance terms vary; we'll include ATA/temporary import docs only if repair chosen.

taylor-infra: operational ask: if we accept 6 now / 4 next-day, can ops pre-stage node images so we cutover within 2h of delivery? Need serials + AWB by 18:00 PT.

dave-procure: provisional approve uplift to avoid capacity gap. I'll send PO amendment memo and wire instructions. Please route final AWB/CI to procurement@redwood and ops@redwood.

kelsey (NexaSupply): sending AWB/CI now to those addresses. AWB primary: 555-88877766 (6 units), AWB secondary: 555-88877767 (4 units). Commercial Invoice: PO RWI-4999; SKU H200-48GB x10; Invoice unit: USD 7,000; Uplift/unit: USD 310; Currency: USD. Serial manifest sent via secure email.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-3355 created for customs + Dedicated provisioning (https://redwood.infra/t/INF-3355).

marcos: executing carrier track: `/track 555-88877766`  and `/track 555-88877767` . I'll update thread if customs clears or if carrier reports a hold. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
